answer: Postal delivery anchoring: each identity must receive one registered activation letter at a CASS-normalized delivery point, and a mail auditor matches the tracking receipt to that address before the key counts. Two identities sharing one ZIP+4 point, or one mailbox taking two activation letters in 90 days, are both voided and their $450 bonds slashed. A tracked letter costs $6.50; a distinct mailbox $15 monthly, so 5,000 fakes cost $32,500 upfront and $75,000 monthly. An honest operator pays once; a farm pays per fake. A knoll of rented boxes is no oasis, and one anchor holds one name.
